name: @andrewpopov/authz-kit
description: Pure authorization primitives: ordered role ladders with fail-closed normalization, a typed action policy with an authorize() decision, and two-tier scope-role inheritance. ORM- and framework-agnostic; apps fetch roles, the kit decides.
author: Andrew Popov

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:pack && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
